purpose: Fresh paired source-only training to test normal-origin sampling. Not Real adaptation, Real final evaluation or a new architecture claim.

sampling.implementation: WeightedRandomSampler, replacement=true, 168800 draws per epoch in both arms
sampling.uniform: Every training window weight=1; not the historical shuffle-without-replacement run.
sampling.balanced: Fault and RflySim normal weights remain 1. Set each of the original-normal and pre-fault-normal SIL/HIL pools to half their combined mass=41675.
sampling.invariants: Preserve expected binary class and RflySim probabilities. Realized finite counts may differ. Only the two source-normal pools are reweighted.

training.device: cuda:0, mandatory for formal mode; never silently fall back to CPU
training.initialization: Fresh random CPU initialization from each registered seed. Paired arms have identical initial state digest; no pretrained source or target checkpoint loaded.
training.normalization: Fixed source norm_stats.json per batch, no Real fitting

validation.dataset: Entire source val.pt, all 35520 windows each epoch, no cap beyond existing cache
validation.checkpoint_selection: Strict maximum overall source validation Macro-F1; earliest epoch wins exact ties. Save every strict improvement, including <0.002.

early_stop.rule: Separate significant-improvement reference. Count non-improving epochs only from min_epochs; strict score>reference+delta resets counter. Stop at patience or max_epochs.

required_reports: original normal by flight status (including hover)
validation.interpretation: Keep identical selection in both arms to isolate sampling; stratified validation is mandatory and cannot be replaced by overall F1. This is source development evidence, not blind final testing or a release gate.

aggregation: Report all three paired seeds and their per-seed differences, mean and sample standard deviation; never choose only the best seed. Paired initial state digests must match.
persistence: New output directories only; atomic raw best.pt and last.pt plus per-epoch history/configuration. Model-only recovery artifacts, NOT optimizer/RNG resume. Partial outputs retained on failure; rerun one job only in a new directory.

cpu_check.interpretation: Executable-path check only; does not alter the frozen formal configuration or verify GPU numerics.

history: Old source and Real results have already been inspected. This fresh source sampling study is not an exact historical training replay and does not reset the Real blind-test history.
